mentions.name: CraftMyGame
mentions.description: No-code game engine with multiplayer built in. It offers a visual event system (similar to Unreal Blueprints / Unity visual scripting) for wiring up physics, combat, inventory, dialogue, and pathfinding, with 55+ systems under the hood. Every game is multiplayer by default via WebSockets with client-side prediction and zero server configuration. The tool is free and is also meant for asset creators to turn sprites into playable games and for developers to prototype quickly.
mentions.problem: Rebuilding the same game systems from scratch on every project, with existing no-code tools feeling too limited; ongoing challenge of convincing people they can build complete games with it.
mentions.audience: Asset creators who have sprites but no way to ship playable games; developers who want to prototype fast without setting up infrastructure; people who want games made for them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
CraftMyGame – no-code game engine with multiplayer baked in

I’ve always loved making games but had the pain of rebuilding the same systems every time. Wanted my own editor with reusable components I could iterate on quickly. Most no-code tools felt too limited, so I built my own.
